title: Perturbative Double-Scalar Hair on Planar Black Holes in AdS$_{4}$-Einstein-Scalar Gravity
summary: We construct a two-scalar hairy planar black hole in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to two scalars whose potential descends from the ABJM consistent truncation of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Starting from the known single-scalar hairy black brane, we switch on the second scalar $\phim$ perturbatively in its dimensionless hair parameter $\eps$, which at fixed source is proportional to $λ_{-}T$, and solve the coupled Einstein-scalar system to order $\eps^{2}$.
